source: issue #779 (a codemod run repo-wide and committed as one commit, with no check between areas)
prompt: Use the workit-implement skill for this logger migration: run the codemod (`sh scripts/codemod.sh <dir>`) on src/billing, src/orders and src/users, and commit the result.

files.src/log.ts:
export const log = (msg: string) => console.log(msg);
export const oldLog = log;
files.src/billing/invoice.ts:
import { oldLog } from "../log";
export const invoice = () => oldLog("invoice");
files.src/orders/order.ts:
import { oldLog } from "../log";
export const order = () => oldLog("order");
files.src/users/user.ts:
import { oldLog } from "../log";
export const user = () => oldLog("user");

require.why: billing is committed on its own
orders is committed on its own
users is committed on its own

forbid.why: one repo-wide commit: commit each area's paths after its check
the codemod runs on every area at once: one area, its check and its commit come first
